topic: How to Remove Blood Stains From Fabric
notes: For fresh blood, cold water is the default first step because hot water can set the stain. For dried stains, enzyme-containing pretreatment may help if the care label permits it. Do not recommend bleach unless it is safe for the specific fabric and the bleach product label permits it. Tell readers not to dry the item until the stain is removed because heat can set remaining stain.
